backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Resume, UserProfile, JobRole, Skill with proficiency levels) and core functions including resume validation, job role management, and access control using mixins for authorization and blob storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: admin-only access enforcement, skill proficiency level display, and proficiency-aware skill matching/gap analysis logic.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components and services including authentication, admin panel, analysis workflow, resume upload, skill matching, gap analysis, and PDF report generation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements like backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tags and a root div for mounting the app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analysis flow, dashboard, and admin panel; includes authentication state management, profile setup modal, and theme provider.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying an access denied message with a shield icon and return-to-home button for unauthorized users attempting to access restricted areas.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions using useIsCallerAdmin hook and renders children only for authorized admins, otherwise shows AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteDia: AlertDialog component for confirming resume deletion with cancel/confirm actions, displaying the resume name and showing loading state during deletion.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that generates and downloads personalized PDF analysis reports including job role, skill matches, gaps, recommendations, and resume context using the pdfGenerator service.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Displays skill gap analysis results in a two-column card layout, showing matching skills (with green styling) and missing/insufficient proficiency skills (with red/yellow styling), categorized by technical and soft skills with color-coded proficiency badges.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing job roles with title, description, and dynamic skill list management; validates inputs and uses mutations to add/update job roles with toast notifications for success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleMatchResu: Displays a list of job role match results sorted by compatibility percentage, showing match scores, progress bars, skill counts, and a button to view detailed gap analysis for each role.
Radio group component that fetches and displays available job roles with their required skills as selectable cards, showing loading skeletons and handling empty states.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header containing navigation (Analyze, Admin for admins), mobile menu toggle, login button, and footer; handles authenticated/unauthenticated states and routing.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login/logout states using Internet Identity, clears query cache on logout, and displays loading spinner during authentication.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart visualization using Recharts that displays the distribution of matching vs. missing skills across three proficiency levels (beginner, intermediate, advanced).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal component for initial user profile setup with form fields for name (required), email, education, and experience. Uses useSaveCallerUserProfile hook to save profile data and prevents closing until completed.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for skill gaps, showing recommended courses with provider links and practice projects for each missing skill. Shows success message if no gaps exist.
frontend/src/components/ResumeList.tsx: Lists uploaded resumes with metadata (skills, experience, education counts), supports selection and deletion with confirmation dialog. Handles loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: Handles PDF resume upload with validation (type, size), parses content using NLP service, extracts skills, validates required sections (experience, technical skills, education), and converts to backend format before uploading.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component displaying matching vs missing skills grouped by category (Technical and Soft Skills) using Recharts library.
Pie chart component visualizing the proportion of matching skills vs missing skills using Recharts library.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and authentication status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, job roles, and resumes, including queries and mutations that interact with the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, featuring an education-focused color palette with warm coral, teal, and amber tones.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin-only page for managing job roles with CRUD operations, displaying role details with skill requirements and proficiency levels in a card-based UI.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Displays comprehensive skill analysis results including match percentages, gap analysis, recommendations, and charts after resume analysis is complete.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Main analysis workflow page allowing authenticated users to upload or select resumes, view job role matches, and navigate to detailed analysis.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the skill gap analysis process, prompting users to login and start analysis.
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Compares resume skills against job role requirements to identify missing skills, matching skills, and skills with insufficient proficiency levels. Includes validation for resume experience and education data.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Parses PDF resume files to extract structured data including contact info, skills, work experience, education, and certifications. Handles text extraction from PDF bytes with fallback for encrypted or image-based PDFs.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based PDF reports containing skill gap analysis results, matching/missing skills, personalized recommendations, and candidate profile information from resume context.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Provides personalized course and project recommendations for missing skills using predefined databases of learning resources from platforms like Udemy, Coursera, and official documentation.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts and categorizes technical and soft skills from parsed resume data by matching against predefined skill lists, normalizes skill names, and estimates candidate experience level and years of experience.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Implements skill matching algorithms that compare resume skills against job role requirements, calculating match percentages and identifying matching/missing skills. Includes proficiency level comparison using a hierarchy (beginner < intermediate < advanced).
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, typography settings, container queries, animations, and custom design tokens for the UI theme.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking the Skill Gap Analyzer application state, including architectural notes (Motoko backend, React frontend, Internet Identity auth), existing features for admin access control and skill proficiency display, and pending feature requests for CRUD operations.
